stem: Which sentence from the selection suggests that the author likes sloths?

options.label: F
options.text: The sloth is the slowest mammal on Earth. (paragraph 1)

options.label: G
options.text: One thing that scientists do know is that sloths are very different from most other animals. (paragraph 2)

options.label: H
options.text: With gentle brown eyes and a flat little nose, the sloth might win the award for cutest animal. (paragraph 4)

options.label: J
options.text: Sloths grow to be only about 25 inches long—around the size of a human baby. (paragraph 4)
